achievements.name: Windward Lands
achievements.description: Completed mission: The Desert Trotters.

steps: Progress through the main story until you reach the Windward Plains.
Complete the assigned mission 'The Desert Trotters' to unlock this achievement.

achievements.name: Giant Crown
achievements.description: Obtained your first silver crown or higher in the Hunting Log.

steps: Hunt large monsters repeatedly — crown sizes are randomized per encounter.
Check the Hunting Log after each hunt. A silver or gold crown icon next to a monster means it was an unusually large specimen.
This will happen naturally as you play; no special setup needed.

achievements.name: The Bigger They Are...
achievements.description: Successfully mounted a monster for the first time.

steps: Attack a monster while jumping off a ledge or slope to trigger a mount.
Alternatively, use aerial attacks or the Insect Glaive vault to land on a monster.
Once mounted, follow the on-screen prompts to hold on and attack.

achievements.name: Shadow in the Downpour
achievements.description: Completed mission: Beyond the Deluge.

steps: Progress the main story until you reach the Scarlet Forest region.
Complete the story mission 'Beyond the Deluge'.

achievements.name: The Hunt Is On!
achievements.description: Completed your first Field Survey.

steps: Field Surveys become available early in the game from the Quest Board.
Accept and complete any Field Survey quest to unlock this achievement.

achievements.name: Was It a Meal to Remember?
achievements.description: Cooked over the BBQ Grill for the first time.

steps: Open your item pouch and select Raw Meat.
Use the BBQ Spit from your item bar in any map.
Wait for the cooking animation — you don't need a well-done steak, any result counts.

achievements.name: Hunters United
achievements.description: Completed a quest via multiplayer.

steps: Join or create a multiplayer session from the Quest Board.
Complete any quest with at least one other player in your party.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: You can fire an SOS Flare during a quest to let random players join, or join others' SOS quests from the board.

achievements.name: Guardians of the Forge
achievements.description: Completed mission: Long-forgotten Flame.

steps: Continue the main story past the Scarlet Forest.
Complete the story mission 'Long-forgotten Flame'.

achievements.name: A Step Toward Mutual Understanding
achievements.description: Completed your first side mission.

steps: Side missions appear as speech bubble icons on the map and in camp.
Talk to the NPC offering the mission and complete its objective.

achievements.name: Bringer of Harmony
achievements.description: Completed mission: Monster Hunter.

steps: Progress through the main story campaign.
Complete the mission 'Monster Hunter' — this is a major story milestone.

achievements.name: Hit 'Em Where It Hurts!
achievements.description: Landed 50 successful attacks on weak points or wounds in Focus Mode.

steps: Enter Focus Mode by pressing the designated button during combat.
Aim for glowing weak points or wound marks on the monster.
Land 50 total Focus Mode hits on weak points across all hunts — this is cumulative.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Wound a monster part first with wound-capable attacks, then Focus Mode attacks on wounds count. You'll get this naturally within a few hunts.

achievements.name: New Ecosystems
achievements.description: Completed mission: New Ecosystems.

steps: Continue the main story after reaching the Oilwell Basin.
Complete the story mission 'New Ecosystems'.

achievements.name: Hunter-Assassin
achievements.description: Performed your first successful Sneak Attack.

steps: Crouch and approach a monster from behind or while it is sleeping.
When the Sneak Attack prompt appears, press the attack button to perform it.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Easiest on sleeping monsters. Crouch with your weapon sheathed and approach from behind.

achievements.name: Angling for a Bite
achievements.description: Successfully fished for the first time.

steps: Find a fishing spot (rippling water with fish visible) in any map.
Interact with the spot to cast your line and catch any fish.

achievements.name: Ride-or-die Companion
achievements.description: Customized your Seikret or changed its decorations for the first time.

steps: Go to the Seikret customization station in the main hub.
Change any cosmetic option — color, equipment, or decorations — and confirm.

achievements.name: A Bitter Environment
achievements.description: Completed mission: Wyvern Sparks and Rose Thorns.

steps: Progress the main story into the Iceshard Peaks area.
Complete the story mission 'Wyvern Sparks and Rose Thorns'.

achievements.name: A True Hunter Is Never Satisfied
achievements.description: Completed 50 quests.

steps: Complete any 50 quests — story missions, side missions, investigations, and field surveys all count.
Track your total in the Guild Card or quest log.

achievements.name: Beyond the Black Wings
achievements.description: Completed mission: A World Turned Upside Down.

steps: Continue the main story to its climactic chapter.
Complete the story mission 'A World Turned Upside Down'.
This is a challenging late-game fight — ensure your gear is upgraded.

achievements.name: Let the Investigations Begin!
achievements.description: Completed your first investigation.

steps: Investigations unlock by collecting monster tracks and traces in the field.
Check the Quest Board for available investigations and complete any one.

achievements.name: One Corner of the World
achievements.description: Completed mission: What Lies Ahead.

steps: This is the final main story mission.
Complete 'What Lies Ahead' to finish the main campaign and unlock this achievement.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: This unlocks the endgame and HR uncap. Make sure to watch the credits for the achievement to pop.

achievements.name: Campmaster
achievements.description: Established Pop-up Camps in 10 places.

steps: While exploring maps, look for Pop-up Camp sites (marked with a tent icon when discovered).
Interact with the site and place a camp.
Establish 10 camps total across all maps.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Camp locations are scattered across all maps. Explore thoroughly during Fallow and Plenty periods — some sites only appear in specific weather.

achievements.name: Impregnable Defense
achievements.description: Forged five different pieces of armor with Rarity 7 or higher.

steps: Hunt high-rank or endgame monsters to gather materials for Rarity 7+ armor.
Visit the Smithy and forge five distinct armor pieces of Rarity 7 or above.
They don't need to be from the same set — mix and match freely.

achievements.name: Monster Slayer
achievements.description: Hunted 100 large monsters.

steps: Hunt any large monsters — both kills and captures count toward this total.
Track your progress in the Hunting Log under total hunts.
You'll likely reach this naturally while working toward crown achievements.

achievements.name: Monster Ph.D.
achievements.description: Hunted many different large monsters.

steps: Hunt at least one of every available large monster species in the game.
Check the Hunting Log to see which monsters you haven't hunted yet.
Some monsters only appear in specific quests or conditions.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: The exact requirement is typically all large monsters in the base game. Check your Hunting Log for any with 0 hunts.

achievements.name: A Legacy Restored
achievements.description: Obtained an Artian Weapon of Rarity 8.

steps: Artian weapons are endgame craftables requiring rare materials from tempered monsters and special drops.
Farm tempered monsters and endgame investigations for Artian materials.
Visit the Smithy and forge any Artian weapon to Rarity 8.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Artian weapons require 'Ancient Texts' found from endgame investigation rewards. Focus on high-rank tempered investigations.
Reddit tip: The Artian tree is hidden until you collect your first Ancient Text material — it won't appear at the Smithy before that.
warnings: Artian materials are rare drops — expect some grind. Use Lucky Cat food skill to improve drop rates.

achievements.name: Glamper
achievements.description: Customized a Pop-up Camp for the first time.

steps: Establish at least one Pop-up Camp in any map first.
Access the camp customization menu and change any decoration or layout.

achievements.name: Miniature Crown
achievements.description: Obtained your first miniature crown in the Hunting Log.

steps: Hunt large monsters — each has a randomized size per encounter.
An unusually small specimen will award a miniature crown in the Hunting Log.
This happens naturally over time. Investigations with gold/silver reward boxes have better crown chances.

achievements.name: Power Is Everything
achievements.description: Forged five different weapons with Rarity 7 or higher.

steps: Collect materials from high-rank and endgame monsters.
Forge five different weapons of Rarity 7 or higher at the Smithy.
Weapons from different trees all count — doesn't need to be same weapon type.

achievements.name: Established Hunter
achievements.description: Reached Hunter Rank 100.

steps: Hunter Rank is uncapped after completing the main story.
Continue completing quests — each gives HR experience points.
Focus on high-rank investigations and tempered monster hunts for the most HR XP.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Tempered investigations give significantly more HR XP than regular quests. Spam tempered Elder Dragon investigations for the fastest grind.
Reddit tip: You can also gain HR passively from multiplayer — joining SOS quests is efficient.

achievements.name: Seasoned Hunter
achievements.description: Hunted 50 tempered monsters.

steps: Tempered monsters become available in the endgame through special investigations.
Collect tempered monster tracks in high-rank expeditions to unlock tempered investigations.
Hunt 50 tempered monsters total — any species counts.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Tempered monsters have purple aura and hit harder but give better rewards. They start appearing after you complete the main story.

achievements.name: Bourgeois Hunter
achievements.description: Possessed 1,000,000 zenny.

steps: Accumulate 1,000,000 zenny in your wallet at one time (not lifetime earnings).
Sell excess monster materials and trade-in items to build up funds.
Avoid spending on unnecessary upgrades while saving toward this goal.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Bandit Mantle and selling materials from endgame hunts makes this trivial. You can also sell excess decorations.

achievements.name: Someone Worth Following
achievements.description: Completed 100 quests with your Palico deployed.

steps: Ensure your Palico is set to deploy before each quest (it should be by default).
Complete 100 quests of any type with your Palico in the party.
This stacks naturally — just don't dismiss your Palico.
warnings: If you frequently play 4-player multiplayer, your Palico may not deploy. Solo and 2-player hunts always include Palicos.

achievements.name: Mmm, So Tasty!
achievements.description: Successfully cooked a well-done steak for the first time.

steps: Use Raw Meat on the BBQ Spit from your item bar.
Watch the meat and listen for the jingle — press the button right when the music hits its peak and the meat turns golden brown.
The timing is when the handle turns and the hunter does the signature arm pump.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Classic MH timing — listen for the jingle, not the visuals. Press the button right when the 4th note plays.

achievements.name: East to West, A Hunter Never Rests
achievements.description: Completed 30 different side missions.

steps: Side missions are given by NPCs in camps and hub areas (speech bubble icons).
Complete 30 unique side missions — replaying the same one doesn't count.
Check all regions regularly as new side missions unlock with story progress and HR.

achievements.name: Hunters United Forever
achievements.description: Completed 100 quests via multiplayer.

steps: Complete any 100 quests in multiplayer mode — join SOS flares or play with friends.
All quest types count: story, investigations, field surveys, and events.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: This stacks with other cumulative achievements. Joining SOS quests is the fastest way to grind this.

achievements.name: Newly Forged Bonds
achievements.description: Followed someone for the first time.

steps: After completing a multiplayer quest, view another player's Hunter Profile.
Select the 'Follow' option on their profile.

achievements.name: Capture Pro
achievements.description: Captured 50 monsters.

steps: Weaken a monster until it starts limping (skull icon on minimap when using research).
Place a Shock Trap or Pitfall Trap under the monster.
Throw 2 Tranq Bombs at the trapped monster to capture it.
Repeat for 50 total captures across all hunts.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Capturing gives more materials than carving in most cases, so this pairs well with farming. Always bring traps and tranqs.

achievements.name: A Prize Held High
achievements.description: Caught a creature that bears an ancient wyvern coin.

steps: Look for rare endemic life creatures that carry ancient wyvern coins — these are special golden creatures.
They spawn rarely in specific locations. Use the binoculars to scout from elevated positions.
Approach carefully and capture with your net.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: These golden creatures tend to spawn during Plenty weather phases. Check elevated areas and near water sources.
Reddit tip: The creature can despawn if you get too close too fast — crouch and approach slowly.
warnings: Very rare spawn — may take multiple expeditions. Don't rush the approach or it will flee.

achievements.name: I Caught a Shooting Star!
achievements.description: Caught a creature in the desert that shines like a shooting star.

steps: Go to the Windward Plains at night during clear weather.
Look for a small glowing creature that streaks across the sand like a shooting star.
Approach carefully while crouching and capture it with your net.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: This creature only spawns at night in the Windward Plains. Look in the open desert areas — it moves fast and glows brightly.
Reddit tip: Some players report it spawns more frequently during specific weather transitions. Keep checking across multiple expeditions.
warnings: Extremely rare spawn. Night-only in the Windward Plains. The creature moves quickly so be ready with your net.

achievements.name: A Keen-eyed Observation
achievements.description: Used the binoculars to spot a gold-crown large monster.

steps: Equip your binoculars from the item bar.
Look at a large monster through the binoculars — if it's gold-crown sized, the achievement unlocks.
Best combined with investigations that have gold reward boxes for higher crown chances.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: You can tell a monster is gold crown before engaging — use binoculars from far away. If you've already hunted gold crowns, you know what size to look for.

achievements.name: Top of the Food Chain
achievements.description: Hunted 50 apex predators.

steps: Apex predators are the top-tier monsters in each ecosystem (Elder Dragons and equivalents).
Hunt 50 of them total through investigations, events, and optional quests.
These are endgame monsters — come prepared with maxed gear and appropriate elemental resistances.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Tempered Elder Dragons count and are the most efficient way to grind this since they also give HR XP and rare drops.

achievements.name: Giant Crown Collector
achievements.description: Obtained a gold crown for 10 or more monsters in the Hunting Log.

steps: Hunt monsters repeatedly — each encounter has a random size that may produce a gold crown (largest).
Investigations with gold and silver reward boxes have significantly higher crown chances.
Obtain gold (large) crowns for 10 different monster species.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Event quests often guarantee or greatly boost crown chances. Check the event schedule for crown-hunting quests.
Reddit tip: Measure the monster with binoculars before engaging — learn to eyeball crown sizes to save time.

achievements.name: Monster (Squid) Hunter
achievements.description: Caught a giant squid while fishing.

steps: Fish at designated fishing spots — the giant squid appears rarely at specific locations.
When hooked, the giant squid puts up a significant fight. Follow the reel-in prompts carefully.
Be patient and don't force the line or it will snap.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: The giant squid spawns at deep water fishing spots. Look for an unusually large shadow in the water.
Reddit tip: Use the strongest bait available. The fight takes a while — watch your line tension carefully.
warnings: The squid can break your line if you reel too aggressively. Match the directional inputs and only reel when the tension indicator is safe.

achievements.name: Miniature Crown Collector
achievements.description: Obtained a miniature crown for 10 or more monsters in the Hunting Log.

steps: Hunt monsters repeatedly — miniature crowns are awarded for unusually small specimens.
Investigations with gold/silver reward boxes have better crown odds.
Collect miniature crowns for 10 different monster species.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Miniature crowns can be harder to spot than gold crowns. Use binoculars to gauge size before committing to a hunt.
Reddit tip: Event quests with guaranteed crowns are the best shortcut for both mini and gold crowns.

achievements.name: Explorer of the Eastlands
achievements.description: Obtained 10 different special items of Rarity 6.

steps: Rarity 6 special items are rare collectibles found across all regions of the Forbidden Lands.
Explore thoroughly during expeditions — check gather points, hidden areas, and rare endemic life.
Some Rarity 6 items come from completing specific side missions or investigations.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Many of these items are tied to rare gathering points that only appear during specific weather conditions. Explore during Plenty and Inclemency phases.
Reddit tip: The Geologist skill can help you gather more items per node, increasing your chances at rare drops.

achievements.name: Gossip Hunter
achievements.description: Viewed 30 different Hunter Profiles.

steps: After multiplayer quests, view other hunters' profiles from the results screen or player list.
View 30 unique Hunter Profiles — repeats don't count.
You can also view profiles from the hub social area.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Join SOS quests frequently and view every player's profile after each hunt. This takes care of itself if you do multiplayer regularly.

achievements.name: A-fish-ionado
achievements.description: Reeled in 30 whoppers while fishing.

steps: Fish at various spots across all maps — whoppers are the largest fish at each location.
Look for the biggest shadows or splashes when choosing which fish to target.
Reel in 30 whoppers total across all fishing sessions.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Whoppers are the large fish that put up more of a fight when reeling in. Each fishing spot has different whopper species.
Reddit tip: Craft or buy the best bait to attract larger fish. Patience at each spot pays off.

achievements.name: Giant Crown Master
achievements.description: Obtained a gold crown for many monsters in the Hunting Log.

steps: Obtain gold (large) crowns for all or nearly all large monsters in the game.
Focus on investigations with gold/silver reward boxes for the best crown chances.
Event quests that feature multiple monsters often have boosted crown rates.
Track your progress in the Hunting Log — check which species still need a gold crown.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: This is the hardest grind in the game. Crown RNG can be brutal. Event quests are your best friend.
Reddit tip: Learn to eyeball crown sizes with binoculars. If a monster looks noticeably bigger than usual, commit to the hunt.
Reddit tip: Some players report 200+ hours just for crown achievements. Don't burn yourself out — mix in other activities.
warnings: This is heavily RNG-dependent. No guaranteed way to force gold crowns outside of event quests. Expect a very long grind.

achievements.name: Miniature Crown Master
achievements.description: Obtained a miniature crown for many monsters in the Hunting Log.

steps: Obtain miniature crowns for all or nearly all large monsters in the game.
Investigations with gold/silver reward boxes offer the best crown chances.
Combine this grind with the Giant Crown Master — hunt the same investigations for both.
Track missing crowns in the Hunting Log.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Mini crowns can feel even rarer than gold crowns for some monsters. Don't neglect event quests — they're the most reliable source.
Reddit tip: If a monster looks comically small compared to your character, that's your mini crown. Use binoculars to confirm before committing.
warnings: Same heavy RNG grind as Giant Crown Master. Work on both crown types simultaneously to save time.

achievements.name: Eastward Wings
achievements.description: Obtained all other achievements.

steps: Complete all 49 other achievements in the game.
The crown achievements (Giant Crown Master, Miniature Crown Master) will be the final bottleneck for most players.
This achievement unlocks automatically once all others are earned.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Estimated 80-100 hours for full completion. The crown grind is the majority of that time.
Reddit tip: Plan your route: finish the story, then do multiplayer/cumulative achievements while farming crowns.
warnings: Requires Hunters United Forever (100 multiplayer quests) — make sure to play online regularly throughout your playthrough.
